answer: Stochastic Pacing Envelope (SPE): each identity gets a per-epoch target inter-arrival distribution with velvet-noise smoothing and slow random wander. The gateway samples arrival timestamps; an identity passes only if its traffic fits that envelope and does not share a phase-lock with other identities. Sybil clusters must run independent clocks, queues, and jitter per puppet, and repeated challenges force continuous timing diversity. Cost: real-time scheduling, bandwidth to sustain plausible idle chatter, and failure/re-enrollment when cross-identity vine-shaped correlation appears.
